t: Founded in 1922, the USSR was the first communist state, ruled by the Communist Party from Moscow.
It industrialised rapidly under Stalin at enormous human cost, then bore the heaviest losses in defeating Nazi Germany.
As a Cold War superpower it rivalled the United States until Gorbachev's reforms led to its peaceful dissolution in 1991.
dyk: The 1924 and later Soviet constitutions formally gave every union republic the right to secede, a provision that only became real in 1990–1991.
ev: Four Soviet republics form the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
Stalin launches the First Five-Year Plan
Germany invades the Soviet Union on 22 June
Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite, is launched
Yuri Gagarin becomes the first person in space
The Soviet Union is dissolved on 26 December

f.successor: Russian Federation and fourteen other independent states
